what: Finding 1: Merged resume can bypass the branch/head mismatch gate the plan assigns to fresh
scenario_or_breakage: A stale state file with PR_CLOSED=true, PHASE=postmerge, MERGE_RESULT in the post-merge set, or a done manifest can classify as merged before any BRANCH_NAME or gh head_ref match check, so postmerge can run for the wrong current branch
suggested_fix: Apply the same current-branch match before accepting merged resume from state, manifest, or gh head_ref; if it mismatches, return fresh

what: Finding 2: Merged resume omits the normal final ship-state done write
scenario_or_breakage: The normal merge path calls run_postmerge_phase then writes PHASE=done, but the proposed merged branch returns run_postmerge_phase directly; a later invocation can keep seeing postmerge or merged state and rerun postmerge
suggested_fix: Mirror the normal path in the merged resume branch: capture the postmerge result, call _write_ship_state(working, phase="done") on success, then return the ShipResult

what: Finding 3: Repo-unavailable open-pr resume can erase hydrated PR_NUMBER and PR_URL
scenario_or_breakage: The plan allows open-pr resume when gh is skipped for repo_unavailable and state BRANCH_NAME matches, but ensure_pr returns number=0 and url="" in that mode; the current assignment pattern would overwrite hydrated resume identity with None and empty URL before the done state/result
suggested_fix: Preserve resume.pr_number and resume.pr_url when ensure_pr returns an empty local-only result, or skip ensure_pr for repo_unavailable open-pr resume after the required gates and write the hydrated done state
